id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_120.pack|cs_: "Oh! I'm off to pick some flowers. There's a lovely field over there. I'll wait outside town, so call me when you're done!
"What's gotten into Sylvando, all of a sudden...
"Lord Jasper is in the biggest mansion in this town. Let's go.
"Oh, and I've kept it from Lord Jasper that I'm the former King of Dundrasil. It would only cause trouble if it got out.
"Here, I'm just Rab the traveler. Please play along with that. Thank you.
